name: Mio
source: The heroine of the Bakumatsu period. A shrine maiden at Mikage Shrine, she possesses a somewhat unearthly beauty, with white hair and skin and red eyes. She has lost much of her sense of self due to constantly taking medicine to maintain her spiritual powers.
